10. Identify 'B' in the following reaction
$\mathrm{C}_2\mathrm{H}_5-\mathrm{OH} \xrightarrow{\mathrm{Al}_2\mathrm{O}_3} \mathrm{A} + \mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O}$
$\mathrm{A} \xrightarrow{\text{Ozonolysis}} \mathrm{B}$.
(a) Glyoxal (b) Formaldehyde
(c) Oxalic acid (d) Acetaldehyde

11. 1 mole of hydrocarbon ‘X’ on complete combustion with 3 moles of $\text{O}_2$ gives
2 moles of $\text{CO}_2$ and 2 moles of water. Then, X can be prepared by
(a) decarboxylation of sodium acetate.
(b) dehydration of ethyl alcohol in the presence of conc. $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$ at $180^\circ\text{C}$.
(c) hydrolysis of calcium carbide.
(d) heating iodoform with silver powder.

12. What would be the pair of products formed by treating alkyne with the least
number of carbon atoms with bromine water?
(a) Dibromoethane, tetrabromoethane
(b) Dibromoethene, tetrabromoethene
(c) Dibromoethane, tetrabromoethene
(d) Dibromoethene, tetrabromoethane.

13. In which among the following reactions does the total number of bonds
remains the same?
(a) Chlorination of methane (b) Hydrogenation of ethene
(c) Dehydration of ethyl alcohol (d) Hydrolysis of ethyne

14. Saturated hydrocarbon with vapour density 8 can be prepared by
__________.
(a) dehydration of alcohol
(b) decarboxylation of sodium acetate
(c) hydrolysis of calcium carbide
(d) hydrogenation of ethene

15. Identify the functional isomers among the following.
(a) Pentanol and dimethyl ether (b) Propanol and dimethyl ether
(c) Butanol and diethyl ether (d) Ethanol and diethyl ether
